StreamMetadata.title: StreamMetadata
StreamMetadata.description:
CV metadata fields plus optional inference parameters for VLM and Embed.

When sent with a stream/add request, the metadata can carry camera-level
information (resolution, codec, framerate) and, optionally, inference
parameters.  The server decides whether to start inference based on:
- VLM: ``prompt`` is provided → start generate_captions
- Embed: ``model`` is provided → start generate_video_embeddings
If neither is set, the stream is added in passthrough mode (no inference).

include_usage.title: Include Usage
include_usage.description: If set, an additional chunk will be streamed before the `data: [DONE]` message. The `usage` field on this chunk shows the token usage statistics for the entire request, and the `choices` field will always be an empty array. All other chunks will also include a `usage` field, but with a null value.

chunk_latency_ms.description: End-to-end chunk processing latency from decode start to VLM response in milliseconds.

queue_time_s.title: Queue Time S
queue_time_s.description: Time this chunk spent queued before processing in seconds.

processing_latency_s.title: Processing Latency S
processing_latency_s.description: Server-side processing latency for this chunk in seconds.

frame_count.title: Frame Count
frame_count.description: Number of selected frames processed for this chunk.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Number of input tokens used by the VLM request for this chunk.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens generated by the VLM for this chunk.

VlmCaptionResponse.title: VlmCaptionResponse
VlmCaptionResponse.description: Represents a VLM caption response for a single chunk.

created.title: Created
created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the VLM captions request was created.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model used for the VLM captions generation.

media_info.title: Media Info
media_info.description: Part of the file / live-stream for which this response is applicable.

chunk_responses.title: Chunk Responses
chunk_responses.description: List of individual chunk responses with timestamps and captions

VlmCaptionsCompletionResponse.title: VlmCaptionsCompletionResponse
VlmCaptionsCompletionResponse.description: Represents a VLM captions response without choices and object fields.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique ID or list of IDs of the file(s)/live-stream(s) to generate VLM captions for

url.title: Url
url.description: URL of the video/image to process. Supported schemes: http://, https://, s3://, file://. When provided, 'id' must also be specified as a single UUID.

url_headers.title: Url Headers
url_headers.description: Optional HTTP headers for URL download (e.g., authorization). Overrides server-level ASSET_DOWNLOAD_AUTH_TOKENS for this request.

media_type.title: Media Type
media_type.description: Media type for the url input: 'image' or 'video'.

creation_time.title: Creation Time
creation_time.description: Creation time in ISO 8601 format. If provided, offsets frame timestamps in the response.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System prompt for the VLM. To enable reasoning with Cosmos Reason1, add <think></think> and <answer></answer> tags to the system prompt. Default max length is 10240; set VLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT_MAX_LENGTH to allow a larger prompt.
examples: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's question.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt for VLM captions generation. Default max length is 10240; set VLM_PROMPT_MAX_LENGTH to allow a larger prompt.
examples: Write a concise and clear dense caption for the provided warehouse video

model.title: Model
model.description: Model to use for this query.

response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: If set, partial message deltas will be sent, like in ChatGPT. Tokens will be sent as data-only [server-sent events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events#Event_stream_format) as they become available, with the stream terminated by a `data: [DONE]` message.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in any given call.

min_tokens.title: Min Tokens
min_tokens.description: Minimum number of tokens to generate before the model is allowed to stop. Used together with `ignore_eos=true` for fixed-length generation. The model will not stop on EOS or any stop string before producing this many output tokens.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: The sampling temperature to use for text generation. The higher the temperature value is, the less deterministic the output text will be.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: The top-p sampling mass used for text generation. The top-p value determines the probability mass that is sampled at sampling time.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering

ignore_eos.title: Ignore Eos
ignore_eos.description: Ignore EOS token in the output.

chunk_duration.title: Chunk Duration
chunk_duration.description: Chunk videos into `chunkDuration` seconds. Set `0` for no chunking

chunk_overlap_duration.title: Chunk Overlap Duration
chunk_overlap_duration.description: Chunk Overlap Duration Time in Seconds. Set `0` for no overlap

media_info.description: Provide Start and End times offsets for processing part of a video file. Not applicable for live-streaming.

num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_ch.title: Num Frames Per Second Or Fixed Frames Chunk
num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_ch.description: Number of frames per second to use for the VLM, when use_fps_for_chunking is True, else it will be fixed number of frames per chunk. If use_fps_for_chunking is True, then this field will be used to determine the number of frames per second to use for the VLM, else it will be fixed number of frames per chunk. Set to -1 with fixed-frame chunking to select all decoded frames in the chunk.

use_fps_for_chunking.title: Use Fps For Chunking
use_fps_for_chunking.description: Use FPS for chunking, if True, then num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_chunk will be interpreted as FPS for sampling frames from the video, else it will be interpreted as the fixed number of frames per chunk

enable_reasoning.title: Enable Reasoning
enable_reasoning.description: Enable reasoning for VLM captions generation

preserve_reasoning_tags.title: Preserve Reasoning Tags
preserve_reasoning_tags.description: Internal flag for NIM-compatible chat completions. When true, model adapters preserve raw reasoning tags in the output instead of stripping them into reasoning_description.

enable_audio.title: Enable Audio
enable_audio.description: Enable transcription of the audio stream in the media

mm_processor_kwargs.title: Mm Processor Kwargs
mm_processor_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for the multimodal processor (e.g., size, shortest_edge, longest_edge).

media_io_kwargs.title: Media Io Kwargs
media_io_kwargs.description: Media I/O pipeline kwargs. For video: {"video": {"fps": 3.0}} or {"video": {"num_frames": 16}}. Positive fps or num_frames values override num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_chunk and use_fps_for_chunking. Use num_frames=-1 to select all decoded frames in the chunk. fps and num_frames are mutually exclusive.

alert_category.title: Alert Category
alert_category.description: Alert type identifier (e.g., 'Worker PPE Violation'). Used for incident.category.
